categories.main_business_segments: TechnipFMC operates two main business segments: Subsea and Surface Technologies. The Subsea segment provides integrated design, engineering, procurement, manufacturing, installation, and life-of-field services for subsea systems and infrastructure used in offshore oil and gas production. The Surface Technologies segment designs, manufactures, and services products and systems for land and shallow water exploration and production of crude oil and natural gas, including drilling, stimulation, production, measurement, and related services.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: TechnipFMC leverages proprietary technologies and integrated production systems, such as iEPCI (integrated Engineering, Procurement, Construction, and Installation), Subsea 2.0 modular product platforms, and digital solutions like Subsea Studio™. Manufacturing methods emphasize pre-engineered, modular, and standardized equipment, advanced robotics, automation, and LEAN manufacturing practices. The company also develops digital platforms for field development, execution, and life-of-field optimization.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The company's primary customers are major integrated oil companies, national oil companies, independent exploration and production companies, and oilfield service companies. Key end markets include offshore deepwater and shallow water oil and gas production, as well as onshore unconventional and conventional oil and gas fields. No single customer accounted for more than 10% of consolidated revenue in 2021.
categories.geographic_coverage: TechnipFMC operates globally, with significant presence in Europe (notably the UK, Norway, France, and the Netherlands), North America (US, Canada, Mexico), Latin America (Brazil), Africa (Nigeria, Angola, Ghana), the Middle East (UAE, Saudi Arabia, Qatar), and Asia Pacific (India, Malaysia, Australia, Singapore, Indonesia). Approximately 80% of 2021 revenue was generated outside the United States.
categories.supply_chain_position: TechnipFMC operates primarily as an integrated equipment and services provider in the midstream and downstream portions of the oil and gas supply chain, focusing on the design, manufacture, installation, and servicing of production systems and infrastructure. The company also provides upstream solutions for wellhead and production systems, and is increasingly involved in life-of-field and digital services.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company's strategic focus is on technology and innovation differentiation, digital transformation, and integrated project delivery to improve project economics and reduce emissions. R&D initiatives target automation, robotics, all-electric fields, modularization (Subsea 2.0), and digital platforms (Subsea Studio™). TechnipFMC is also investing in energy transition areas such as carbon capture and storage, offshore renewables, and hydrogen through its New Energy Ventures.
categories.revenue_model: TechnipFMC generates revenue primarily through the sale of engineered products, systems, and equipment, as well as project-based services (engineering, procurement, construction, and installation), aftermarket services, equipment rentals, and digital solutions. Revenue is recognized over time for long-term contracts and at a point in time for product sales and rentals.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: In Subsea, TechnipFMC is positioned as the only fully integrated provider offering the complete suite of subsea production equipment, umbilicals, flowlines, installation, and life-of-field services. Key competitors include Aker Solutions, Baker Hughes, Dril-Quip, McDermott, National Oilwell Varco, Oceaneering, Schlumberger, and Subsea 7. In Surface Technologies, major competitors are Baker Hughes, Cactus, Forum Energy Technologies, Gardner Denver, Schlumberger, Halliburton, and SPM Oil and Gas.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2021, TechnipFMC reported $6.4 billion in revenue, with Subsea accounting for $5.3 billion and Surface Technologies for $1.1 billion. The company has over 20,000 employees and a global asset base. Subsea inbound orders grew over 20% year-over-year, and total order backlog at year-end was $7.7 billion, indicating a recovery and growth trajectory following the pandemic-driven downturn.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: TechnipFMC emphasizes its ability to deliver integrated, technologically differentiated solutions that improve project economics, enhance performance, and reduce emissions for customers. Its unique iEPCI model, digital platforms, and modular product architectures enable faster, more predictable project delivery and lower total cost of ownership. The company also differentiates through its commitment to innovation, digitalization, and supporting the energy transition.
